inputs: Approved synthetic note text and customer turns from curated.transcripts, with case/customer identity and resolved contact provenance checks. Public label fields are targets only, never text inputs.
shared_definition: train_classifier.tokens is called by both fit and predict; normalized/redacted unique word and adjacent-word-pair occurrences, with minimum training document frequency 2.
split: Connected components of shared golden customer, identical normalized/redacted text or identical complete word/bigram token signatures. SHA256 of sorted component IDs modulo 5 selects development evaluation groups.
excluded: Missing or unapproved matching sources; resolved account/customer or transcript/contact contradictions; rows labeled as mentioning protected attributes.
allowed_uses: Display other model flags for comparison with rules
live_choice: Shared review_signals uses positive hardship rules OR model score >= 0.95 without explicit hardship/affordability denial. This score threshold is an uncalibrated development safeguard, not a probability. Rare-class models do not replace stronger rules.
limitations: Short live utterances differ from full notes/calls
